unique_mapped_population_exposed.method: GHSL 2025 population inside the spatial union of public/significant exposure-grade footprints only; overlapping mapped footprints are counted once
unique_mapped_population_exposed.interpretation: Cross-hazard headline excludes context-grade flood event areas and risk-grade drought areas; it is mapped exposure, not verified unique affected individuals.

flood_reported_event_area_population_con.method: GHSL 2025 population inside the union of public/significant GDACS reported flood event/affected-area polygons
flood_reported_event_area_population_con.interpretation: Context only: these polygons are not observed inundation extent and are excluded from the cross-hazard exposure headline.

event_deduped_source_population_sum.method: maximum preferred source/model population metric per public/significant stable event, then event-level sum
event_deduped_source_population_sum.interpretation: Stable events are counted once but people shared by different events may still be counted more than once; secondary diagnostic only.

drought_crop_area_within_mapped_risk_foo.method: FAO CROPGRIDS 2020 physical crop area inside the spatial union of public/significant mapped drought risk/impact footprints
drought_crop_area_within_mapped_risk_foo.interpretation: Spatial crop exposure/context, not confirmed crop damage or crop loss.
